source: MolRep released Liver.csv and attributions.npz; source-provided literature-alert atom masks
exclusion: any full or largest-fragment stereo-insensitive identity overlap with original B-XAIC/Graph Attribution families; conflicting duplicate groups excluded, otherwise official-test/earliest-row precedence
atom_order: original released SMILES, never canonicalized before mask alignment
split: preserve admitted official test; within each class sort remaining train by SHA-256(salt+stereo-insensitive canonical full identity), first round(20%) calibration, next round(15%) development, remainder fit
architecture: 3 message-passing layers, hidden dimension 32, sum pooling, 3-class linear head
features: 33 atom features: element B/C/N/O/F/Si/P/S/Cl/Br/I plus unknown; degree 0..5 plus unknown; formal charge -2..2 plus unknown; H count 0..4 plus unknown; aromatic and ring indicators
training: CPU, 4 threads; Adam lr=0.001 weight_decay=0.0001; batch=64; inverse-class-frequency weighted sampling; gradient norm clip=2; maximum 100 epochs; minimum 20; patience 15; development macro-OVR AUROC improvement > 1e-5
gradient_input: sum feature times raw-logit gradient; signed atom score
integrated_gradients: zero baseline, 20 right-Riemann steps, raw-logit target; signed feature sum
saliency: sum of absolute raw-logit input gradients
occlusion: intact target logit minus zero-one-atom-feature logit; topology unchanged; signed atom score
crc: smallest fraction with (sum(calibration loss)+1)/(n+1) <= alpha; full-set fallback explicitly flagged if infeasible
bootstrap: 2000 shared test-molecule draws, seed 20260912; average six fixed models per molecule before resampling; percentile 95% intervals conditional on calibration and fitted checkpoints
class_strata: shared all-nonempty calibration; no subgroup recalibration
reference_boundary: literature-alert operational reference, not experimental causal atom truth; released masks retained despite 48/587 disagreements with independently reconstructed printed SMARTS union
release_boundary: original analysis code and structure-free aggregate results only; source files, molecule identities, masks, scores, checkpoints and row-level outputs stay external
